messages:
Maya (product): Quick checkin  we need a tight, operationally realistic GA acceptance checklist focused on: SLA commitments, pricing windows, docs for migration, support routing, and legal signoffs. Goal: a one-page decision vector for the PM on GA flip. Who volunteers to draft sections?

Alex (eng-platform): I can sketch the runtime ops section. Key constraints: two configurable knobs (max_latency_ms, batch_cap) and a traffic-shape flag for initial traffic ramp. We should require these to be observable in Console before GA.

Ravi (sre): I'll own the monitoring/oncall piece. Minimum: per-model p95, p99, error-rate, and a burn-rate chart for first 72h. Need an automated circuit-breaker: if error > 2.5% for 3m -> cut traffic to 10%.

Lina (legal): I'll sign off on data residency language if the product forbids retention > 30 days for pilot customers. Also need to see the customer-facing SLA doc draft before legal approves.

Nora (finance): For pricing, propose a two-window approach: Pilot-band (discounted, vetted cohort) for 30 days, then GA published pricing. Need unit math examples for tokenized vs embedding usage. Also want an estimated $/1000 token typical for standard vs priority.

Maya (product): Good. Let's capture minimal pass/fail criteria for the PM decision: 1) docs (quickstart + migration), 2) monitoring & alerts live, 3) legal OK on SLA + Data, 4) pricing published (pilot bands noted), 5) 48h clean canary. If any missing -> hold.

Alex (eng-platform): Implementation note: add a feature-flagged fallback list for quantized variants. Example config in SDK quickstart:
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v1",
  "fallback_models": ["redwood-v1-quant8", "redwood-v1-fp16"],
  "max_latency_ms": 200,
  "traffic_shape": "canary:5%"
}
```
(we'll adapt syntax for final SDK).

Ravi (sre): Alert thresholds suggestion: p95 > 700ms for 5m -> P2; error rate > 2.5% for 3m -> P1; sustained error >1% for 15m -> P1. I'll create dashboards and OpsPager rules. Also recommend a dedicated slack channel `#ga-launch-watch` with alert forwarding.

Lina (legal): Clarify the SLA exceptions: we need to call out quantization compatibility as a non-guaranteed quality vector (i.e., priority tier may require unquantized variants for certain features). That needs to be in the legal SLA annex.

Nora (finance): I'll publish the pricing table draft and a small calculator snippet for CSMs. Also suggest an early-customer credit provision in the pilot band to limit billing disputes.

Maya (product): Timeline: canary -> 2025-09-02 18:00Z (5% traffic, 72h window). PM decision checkpoint: 2025-09-05 12:00Z. If no P1 incidents and monitoring shows stable SLO burn, we flip to GA in stages.

DeployBot: scheduled: canary group enrolled. Will post canary metrics every 15m.

Alex (eng-platform): Operational items I will deliver: Console visibility for knobs (48h), fallback model table in infra README (24h), and API docs snippet (48h).

Ravi (sre): My deliverables: dashboards + alerts (48h), OpsPager rota for first month (48h), rollback automation (pairing with Alex) (72h).

Lina (legal): Deliverables: SLA draft + annex on quantization compatibility (72h), data-residency checkbox for pilot contracts (48h).

Nora (finance): Deliverables: pricing table + customer calculator + pilot credit terms (48h).

Maya (product): I'll produce the one-page "GA decision vector" (today) and coordinate the PM signoff. If SRE finds >1 P1 in canary window -> hold GA and run postmortem with the owners.

Alex (eng-platform): One more note: advise customers to set `max_batch_latency_ms` explicitly for low-latency use cases. We'll add a small paragraph in the quickstart and sample env var: `RW_MAX_BATCH_LATENCY_MS=50`.

Maya (product): Perfect. Priors: keep canary cohort targeted (existing beta users + 3 pilot accounts). Do not expand traffic until 48h clean.

Ravi (sre): A couple quick checks for the runbook: who does handoff to Sales/CSMs on SLA questions? Maya or Lina?

Maya (product): I'll handle initial CSM handoffs; Lina handles legal/contractual escalations. We'll list contact points in the pinned runbook.

Nora (finance): Suggest we include a "billing hold" play: if a pilot customer flags unexpected charges, auto-suspend billing for 7 days pending investigation. Ops to implement webhook?

Alex (eng-platform): We can add billing-suspend webhook but need an ops review. I'll pair with Nora if she drafts the webhook spec.

Maya (product): Action items recap (owner - due):
- GA decision vector doc (Maya - today)
- Console knobs + README + SDK snippet (Alex - 48h)
- Dashboards & alerts + rota (Ravi - 48h)
- SLA + quantization annex (Lina - 72h)
- Pricing table + pilot credit + billing hold spec (Nora - 48h)
- Create `#ga-launch-watch` and pin runbook (Maya - today)

DeployBot: reminder scheduled: will send canary health summary at T+15m after rollout start.

Maya (product): Thanks everyone. Post progress updates here; PM will sign off at checkpoint if all green. :rocket:
